answer: A factory can mint names and flood a lagoon of cheap attestations. Each applicant locks an 18-day vault bond of 0.8 percent of last epoch's median spendable, released only after five final peers countersign a falcon tag: a 28-hour courier code hashed with a measured clock skew. Clerks recompute the five signatures and open the hash at a listed drop. If any peer is reused, the courier code was seen before, or the funding key already sponsored two failed tags this week, the bond is paid to the five peers and that key cannot open a new vault for two epochs, which sockpuppets cannot amortize.
